findings.message: The new guard in packages/test-tools/src/headlessClient.ts (lines 59-62), which throws when room.connection.events.onmessage is missing, has no test for its failure branch. No unit test builds a room without the hook and expects the clear error. Only the success path runs, indirectly, through the integration suite and the build smoke test. The acceptance requires unit tests only for findings 3-5, so this does not block, but the 'fails clearly' behaviour is unverified.
findings.requirement: Guard it with an assertion that fails clearly if the hook is missing, and note the SDK version it depends on.
